title: %rowNumber - add sequential row numbers
purpose: Tag each element with a 1-based _rowNum field.
notes: Primitive elements are wrapped as { _rowNum, value } objects.
The array is supplied as a JSON-array string so the added _rowNum field surfaces in the output.

avoid.why: a typed ODIN array block wraps each element, so the added _rowNum field is dropped from the serialized output; supply the array as a JSON-array string literal instead
